Il polso si studia sempre in due proiezi: The wrist is always studied in two views: the AP shows the fracture and any extension into the joint, the lateral shows displacement (dorsal in Colles fracture, volar in Smith) and the tilt of the articular surface. On the AP check radial height, radial inclination, ulnar variance, the ulnar styloid, the carpal arcs (Gilula) and the scaphoid. A displaced or intra-articular fracture is reduced and often operated; an undisplaced one is immobilised and followed up.
